verdict.rationale: The evidence shows SendGrid's own dynamic template system (versioned via SendGrid's UI/API) but contains no mention of React Email, MJML, or any first-party documented code-based templating framework that would let developers author templates as code and store them in version control. Missing for 10: any reference to React Email/MJML/JSX-to-HTML pipeline, official docs or SDK support for git-based template workflows, or vendor guidance on integrating such frameworks.
